capabilities: open a random daily note via command or hotkey
switch past daily notes to reading mode automatically
toggle auto reading mode in settings
intentEvidence: Adds a command to open a random daily note from your vault.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to jump to a random past daily note, and old daily notes open in editing mode when you only want to read them.
summary: Daily notes add-on that adds a command to open a random daily note and can switch past daily notes to reading mode on open.
